ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
RS2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District, B3-1, Community Shopping
District, B3-2, Community Shopping District, and M1-1, Limited Manufacturing/Business
Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-G in the area bound by:

the alley next north of an parallel to West 115" Street; South Morgan Street; the alley
next south of and parallel to West 115" Street; a line 83.1 feet west of and parallel to
South Carpenter Street; West 115" Street; a line 108.1 feet east of and parallel to South
May Street; the alley next south of and parallel to West 115" Street; South Racine
Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West 115" Street; South Elizabeth Street;
the alley next south of and parallel to West 115" Street; a line 58.15 feet west of South
Elizabeth Street; West 115'" Street; and, South Racine Avenue

to those of RT4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
